topic: Direction Light and Exterior Light Switch Process Status Parameters
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific service interface or parameter related to direction light error status and mode status.
column_semantics: The columns represent different system components or modules (SOA, ICB, LHZCU) and their interaction with the network fault status for the respective parameters.

core_conditions.name: DirectionLightErrorStatus
core_conditions.description: Service interface to query the direction light error status after subscribing to the right turn signal.

core_conditions.name: DirectionLightModeStatus
core_conditions.description: Service interface to query the direction light mode status.

core_faults.name: Network Fault Status
core_faults.description: Indicates the network fault status affecting the communication between components.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the parameters and interfaces for querying the error status and mode status of direction lights, which can be used to verify the correct operation and fault detection of the direction light system in response to various inputs and network conditions.
